record_title: Generalized packing–covering conjecture through redundancy fifteen
provenance: A refinement of the redundancy-bounded argument of Essayag--Zabokritskiy, arXiv:2609.19098v1, resolving their first remaining binary parameter triple by a finite-geometric bound on the fourth generalized Hamming weight of a shortened six-dimensional dual code.
limitations: The result extends the uniform redundancy threshold from 14 to 15 only; it does not settle redundancy 16 or the general conjecture. The binary six-dimensional lemma is specialized to the residual case and is not claimed as a general classification theorem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.19098v1 is very recent.
